scope: Private trace file permissions and publication behavior; not a full-model numeric comparison, calibrated Gamma, GPU execution, or E2E proof.
finding: The original trace file inherited the process umask and could retain group/other read bits after atomic publication.
resolution: Both the native create-new writer and the Python publication wrapper force mode 0600. The wrapper still removes staged partial output on timeout and rolls back a published trace if report publication fails.

checks.command: cargo clippy --offline --locked -j 1 -p volta-pcs --features c71-b12-pcs --example c71_calibration -- -D clippy::correctness -D clippy::suspicious
